_comment: App sections and tabs. The one definition: src/constants/appLayout.js (shared by the app and the server), src/constants/sections.js (app) and lib/sections.js (server) all read this file. perTester sections are the ones a beta tester is given one by one (beta_testers.sections; its check constraint lists the same keys) and their order matters: a tester with one section lands on the first. Placeholder sections (built: false) are never per-tester: their audience decides. status/audience here are the defaults; the app_sections table (/admin -> Sections) overrides them, plus title, blurb, sort order and featured. Tab labels and the Home block order live in app_layout. icon is a key in src/components/Icon.jsx (line SVGs).
